import numpy as np
import metpy.calc as mpcalc
from metpy.units import units
from metpy.io import parse_metar_to_dataframe
from metpy.cbook import get_test_data
from metpy.calc import wind_components, dewpoint_from_relative_humidity, bunkers_storm_motion, critical_angle, significant_tornado, supercell_composite
import pandas as pd

def effective_inflow_layer(p, T, Td, u, v, cape_thresh=100 * units('joule / kilogram'), cin_thresh=-250 * units('joule / kilogram')):
    """
    Determine the effective inflow layer following Thompson et al. (2004).
    Returns the pressure bounds (top, bottom) of the effective inflow layer.
    """
    # Compute CAPE and CIN for each level as a parcel
    cape = []
    cin = []
    for i in range(len(p)):
        prof_p = p[i:]
        prof_T = T[i:]
        prof_Td = Td[i:]
        if len(prof_p) < 3:
            cape.append(np.nan)
            cin.append(np.nan)
            continue
        prof = mpcalc.parcel_profile(prof_p, prof_T[0], prof_Td[0])
        this_cape, this_cin = mpcalc.cape_cin(prof_p, prof_T, prof_Td, prof)
        cape.append(this_cape)
        cin.append(this_cin)
    cape = np.array(cape) * units('joule / kilogram')
    cin = np.array(cin) * units('joule / kilogram')
    # Find layers where CAPE >= threshold and CIN >= threshold
    mask = (cape >= cape_thresh) & (cin >= cin_thresh)
    if not np.any(mask):
        return None, None
    indices = np.where(mask)[0]
    bottom = p[indices[0]]
    top = p[indices[-1]]
    return top, bottom

# Read in sample data (using MetPy's test data)
data = pd.read_csv(get_test_data('sounding_data.txt', as_file_obj=False), delim_whitespace=True, comment='#', header=None,
                   names=['pressure', 'height', 'temperature', 'dewpoint', 'direction', 'speed'])

# Isolate needed variables and attach units
p = data['pressure'].values * units.hPa
T = data['temperature'].values * units.degC
Td = data['dewpoint'].values * units.degC
u, v = mpcalc.wind_components(data['speed'].values * units.knots, data['direction'].values * units.degrees)

# Compute common sounding index parameters
ml_p, ml_T, ml_Td = mpcalc.mixed_layer(p, T, Td, depth=100 * units.hPa)
mu_p, mu_T, mu_Td = mpcalc.most_unstable_parcel(p, T, Td, depth=300 * units.hPa)

# Surface-based parcel
sfcp = p[0]
sfcT = T[0]
sfcTd = Td[0]

# Parcel profile for surface-based parcel
parcel_prof = mpcalc.parcel_profile(p, sfcT, sfcTd)

# LI, CAPE, CIN for surface parcel
li = mpcalc.lifted_index(p, T, parcel_prof)
cape, cin = mpcalc.cape_cin(p, T, Td, parcel_prof)

# LCL, LFC, EL for surface parcel
lcl_pressure, lcl_temperature = mpcalc.lcl(sfcp, sfcT, sfcTd)
lfc_pressure, lfc_temperature = mpcalc.lfc(p, T, Td)
el_pressure, el_temperature = mpcalc.el(p, T, Td)

# Mean layer parcel (100 hPa)
ml_parcel_prof = mpcalc.parcel_profile(p, ml_T, ml_Td)
ml_cape, ml_cin = mpcalc.cape_cin(p, T, Td, ml_parcel_prof)

# Most unstable parcel
mu_parcel_prof = mpcalc.parcel_profile(p, mu_T, mu_Td)
mu_cape, mu_cin = mpcalc.cape_cin(p, T, Td, mu_parcel_prof)

# Bunkers Storm Motion vector
right_mover, left_mover = bunkers_storm_motion(p, u, v, T, Td)
rm_u, rm_v = right_mover
lm_u, lm_v = left_mover

# Critical angle
crit_angle = critical_angle(p, u, v, T, Td)

# Effective inflow layer
eff_top, eff_bottom = effective_inflow_layer(p, T, Td, u, v)

# Significant Tornado Parameter (STP)
stp = significant_tornado(p, T, Td, u, v)

# Supercell Composite Parameter (SCP)
scp = supercell_composite(p, T, Td, u, v)

# Print out important sounding parameters
print(f"Surface Pressure: {sfcp:.1f}")
print(f"Surface Temperature: {sfcT:.1f}")
print(f"Surface Dewpoint: {sfcTd:.1f}")
print(f"LCL Pressure: {lcl_pressure:.1f}, LCL Temperature: {lcl_temperature:.1f}")
print(f"LFC Pressure: {lfc_pressure:.1f}, LFC Temperature: {lfc_temperature:.1f}")
print(f"EL Pressure: {el_pressure:.1f}, EL Temperature: {el_temperature:.1f}")
print(f"Surface-based CAPE: {cape:.1f}")
print(f"Surface-based CIN: {cin:.1f}")
print(f"Lifted Index: {li:.1f}")
print(f"Mean Layer CAPE: {ml_cape:.1f}")
print(f"Mean Layer CIN: {ml_cin:.1f}")
print(f"Most Unstable CAPE: {mu_cape:.1f}")
print(f"Most Unstable CIN: {mu_cin:.1f}")
print(f"Bunkers Right Mover: u={rm_u:.1f}, v={rm_v:.1f}")
print(f"Bunkers Left Mover: u={lm_u:.1f}, v={lm_v:.1f}")
print(f"Critical Angle: {crit_angle:.1f}")
print(f"Effective Inflow Layer: Top={eff_top}, Bottom={eff_bottom}")
print(f"Significant Tornado Parameter: {stp:.2f}")
print(f"Supercell Composite Parameter: {scp:.2f}")
```
